items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: Irving Randolph is called Mousy. He's a trumpet player.

ctx.x: I don't think they were outstanding to an extent that he just trained them and they were good for him, but they weren't good for anybody else. I don't know.
Was there a drummer called Mousy? Or maybe it's a trumpet player called Mousy. I'm confused. Irving Randolph is called Mousy. He's a trumpet player.
He never played on the boat, I don't think.
